verdict.rationale: Firebase's Local Emulator Suite is documented for building and testing apps locally across Firestore, Realtime Database, Storage, Auth, Hosting, and Functions. The docs say it lets you run integration tests or QA "without touching production data," and the Firebase Test SDK supports unit tests against it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the emulators work as claimed, evidence tying the sandbox to AI-agent workflows (e.g. MCP server or agents targeting emulators), and full coverage, since the Functions, Pub/Sub and Extensions emulators are still beta.
